caption: The drawing features a full-length dress with a fitted bodice and a wide, bell-shaped skirt. The dress is composed of a light-colored fabric, primarily off-white or pale cream, and is decorated with parallel horizontal stripes and scattered floral motifs in shades of pink and green. The bodice is patterned to match the skirt and is buttoned down the center with a row of blue buttons. The dress has long sleeves that are wide at the cuffs, trimmed with prominent bands of teal or blue-green fabric, which are also applied in a curved line across the upper chest and shoulders. The collar is small and rounded, made from the same light fabric as most of the dress. Off to the right, there is a smaller, outline sketch of the back view of the dress, with no added color or pattern. The background of the drawing is plain and neutral.
title: Dress
